scheme_name: HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth

exit_load.value: Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year.

tax.value: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%.

objective.value: The scheme seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation/income by investing predominantly in Mid-Cap companies.

sections.name: category
sections.title: Category
sections.text: HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth is the Direct plan, Growth option of a scheme from HDFC Mutual Fund. Its category is Equity – Mid Cap.

sections.name: launch_date
sections.title: Launch date
sections.text: The launch date of HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth is 01 Jan 2013.

sections.name: registrar
sections.title: Registrar
sections.text: The registrar and transfer agent of HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth is CAMS.

sections.name: stamp_duty
sections.title: Stamp duty
sections.text: Stamp duty for HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth: 0.005% (from July 1st, 2020).

sections.name: expense_ratio
sections.title: Expense ratio
sections.text: The expense ratio (TER) of HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth is 0.60% excluding GST and statutory charges, and 0.74% including them, as on 10 Nov 2026.

sections.name: exit_load
sections.title: Exit load
sections.text: Exit load of HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth: Exit load of 1% if redeemed within 1 year.

sections.name: minimum_investment
sections.title: Minimum investment / SIP
sections.text: The minimum SIP amount for HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth is ₹100. The minimum first (lump sum) investment is ₹100. The minimum additional investment is ₹100.

sections.name: riskometer
sections.title: Riskometer
sections.text: The riskometer classification of HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth is Very High risk.

sections.name: benchmark
sections.title: Benchmark
sections.text: The benchmark index of HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth is NIFTY Midcap 150 Total Return Index (NIFTY Midcap 150 TRI).

sections.name: fund_manager
sections.title: Fund manager
sections.text: The fund managers of HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth are Chirag Setalvad, Dhruv Muchhal.

sections.name: about_the_fund
sections.title: About the fund
sections.text: Investment objective of HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth: The scheme seeks to provide long-term capital appreciation/income by investing predominantly in Mid-Cap companies.

sections.name: tax
sections.title: Tax
sections.text: Tax on redemption of HDFC Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth: If you redeem within one year, returns are taxed at 20%. If you redeem after one year, returns exceeding Rs 1.25 lakh in a financial year are taxed at 12.5%.
